title: Nowhere To Be. Hoodie
descriptionHtml:
No shift, no schedule, nobody waiting on you.

For the couch or the long way home.

Made to order and shipped to you.

Details

  • Left chest: NOWHERE TO BE., embroidered on two lines, about 68 mm (2.7 in) wide
  • Styles: Oversized or Garment-Dyed
  • Oversized: relaxed fit, dropped shoulders. 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²). Lined hood with no drawcord, front kangaroo pocket
  • Garment-Dyed: relaxed fit. 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing

Which size? See Size & fit.
seoTitle: Nowhere To Be. Embroidered Hoodie | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: No shift, no schedule, nobody waiting on you. Nowhere To Be., embroidered on a hoodie made to order. For the couch or the long way home.

styleNotes.Oversized: Relaxed fit with dropped shoulders, in 80% cotton, 20% recycled polyester fleece, 9.4 oz/yd² (319 g/m²), with a lined hood and no drawcord.
styleNotes.Garment-Dyed: Relaxed fit in 80% ring-spun cotton, 20% polyester, 9.5 oz/yd² (322 g/m²), garment-dyed after sewing.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, open the 2012 US record for NOWHERE TO BE (serial 85784193) on USPTO: it looks like a dead clerical entry. Then search the phrase on USPTO and CIPO for clothing, and on Etsy. So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md).
Never shorten it to NOWHERE: one company's NOWHERE mark covers hats and caps (search snippet only).

The three sweatpants listings say 'Nowhere to be and all day to get there.', and the Punched Out. sweatpants' meta description does too. Change that line now that it's a design, so they don't repeat this one. They're live, so it's your OK.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3. Update the size on the listing if it changes.
Get a sew-out on both styles before selling. Samples cost money, so it's your call.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.
The Lightweight hoodie (1467) is left out until Printful confirms it embroiders it. If it does, add it as a third style with its style note from store/products/drop1.json.
Still open from the first-drop hoodies (store/products/drop1.json): care instructions for each style and Printful's production time with embroidery.

descriptionHtml:

seoTitle: Sun’s Still Up. Embroidered Hat | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: You're off work and there's still daylight left. Sun’s Still Up., embroidered on a hat made to order. For a line in the water or a quick nine.

styleNotes.5-Panel: Structured mid-profile cap in 65% polyester, 35% cotton twill, with a one-piece front (no centre seam) and an adjustable plastic snap closure.

Keep the curly apostrophe (’) in the art and everywhere the name appears. Without it the line reads like a sports score.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3, including the S trims. Update the size on the listing if it changes.

Get a sew-out on both styles before selling. The apostrophe and the S's are the small parts to watch, and Printful reviews of the Rope Cap mention wrinkling and stitches through the lining. Samples cost money, so it's your call.
Check the Rope Cap's front embroidery area on its File guidelines tab (it wasn't found); the stack is about the logo's size, 62 x 18 mm. Both fronts are seamless, so it stays centred on each.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.
Still open from the first-drop hats (store/products/drop1.json): care for each style, and the Rope Cap's material, profile and closure from Printful's spec sheet, for a Details line of its own.

descriptionHtml:

seoTitle: Banked Time. Embroidered Hat | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: The overtime you saved up, taken as days off. Banked Time., embroidered on a hat made to order. For a long stretch at the cottage.

styleNotes.Retro Trucker: Structured six-panel cap with a hard buckram front, mesh back and adjustable plastic snap closure.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, search BANKED TIME on USPTO and CIPO for clothing and hats. The nearest filing found, TIME BANK (US serial 87358423), is for financial services. So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md).

Both styles have a seam down the middle of the front, so the line moves sideways to put the seam in a gap. In the word space (4.9 mm wide) the line sits about 9.3 mm left of centre, which shows. The gap between the E and the D (2.1 mm) needs only 1.9 mm to the right. Pick one on the production art. As with the logo, it isn't confirmed that Printful keeps an offset: check its editor and the sample.
The Dad Hat's six-panel build comes from the preview drawing, not yet from Printful's page (store/products/drop1.json): confirm it before the line moves on that style.

descriptionHtml:

For a lawn chair in the driveway.

seoTitle: Parked. Embroidered Trucker Hat | OFF SHFT
seoDescription: The truck's parked for the night, and so are you. Parked., embroidered on a trucker hat made to order. For a lawn chair in the driveway.

styleNotes.Retro Trucker: Structured six-panel cap with a hard buckram front, mesh back and adjustable plastic snap closure.

toConfirm: Before ordering samples, search PARKED and NATIONALLY PARKED on USPTO and CIPO for clothing and hats (the Disc Golf Pro Tour sells Nationally Parked hats; no filing found). PARKE, a women's clothing brand that sells hats, is one letter off, so look at a mockup with that in mind. So far it's web search only (designs/phrases/notes.md).

The trucker has a seam down the middle of the front, so PARKED. moves about 1.7 mm right of centre to put the seam in the gap between the R and the K (2.0 mm, the gap nearest the middle). As with the logo, it isn't confirmed that Printful keeps an offset: check its editor and the sample.

No production art yet: the size here is from the quick preview (designs/phrases/previews/sizes.json). It needs its own build and checks before digitizing, like designs/09-punched-out/v3. Update the size on the listing if it changes.
Get a sew-out on the trucker before selling: that 2.0 mm gap is narrower than the 2.4 mm one Punched Out. uses for the seam. Samples cost money, so it's your call.

Colours come later: you add them. Thread colours follow the fabric, once a sew-out on the real blank passes. Then each style gets linked to its Printful product and embroidery file, or orders won't reach Printful.
Still open from the first-drop hats (store/products/drop1.json): care, and the trucker's fabric, left out because the maker is changing the blend, so stock may be mixed.
